UPDATE core.objects SET kind = $2::text::core.object_kind, name = $3, name_kk = $4,
                address = $5, address_kk = $6, area_m2 = $7, floor_part = $8,
                premises_type_code = $9, premises_kind_code = $10,
                comfort_code = $11, location_code = $12
             WHERE id = $1
